concepts.name: capture
concepts.definition: Recording one analytics event in an SDK: the SDK builds the event with its properties, runs it past the before-send hooks, and queues it to be sent to PostHog.

concepts.name: session
concepts.definition: A run of one visitor's activity in a client SDK, named by a session id. The browser SDK starts a new one after the idle timeout (30 minutes by default) or after 24 hours.

concepts.name: session replay
concepts.definition: The product that records what happened on a page (the DOM, with rrweb) during a session so it can be played back. A single played-back session is a recording.

concepts.name: extension
concepts.definition: An opt-in browser SDK feature (autocapture, surveys, session replay, web vitals and more) that implements the Extension interface from @posthog/browser-common, and in posthog-js is often lazy-loaded from the CDN.

concepts.name: survey
concepts.definition: A PostHog product: questions shown to visitors in the app, rendered by the surveys extension, whose answers are captured as events.

concepts.name: identify
concepts.definition: Linking the current anonymous distinct id to a known user's id, so later events belong to that person.

concepts.name: autocapture
concepts.definition: Capturing clicks, changes and form submits in the browser without the app calling capture for each one.

concepts.name: group
concepts.definition: A company, team or other entity that events can be tied to, set with the group call, for group analytics.

concepts.name: scenario
concepts.definition: A GIVEN/WHEN/THEN case under a requirement in a PostHog/sdk-specs capability spec; invariants cite the requirement or scenario they come from.
